discourse.title: Unity is our life breath
discourse.occasion: First Overseas Convention of Chairs of Sai Centres
discourse.excerpt: Members of Sai Organisations should consider unity as their very life breath.
discourse.theme: Unity is not an organisational nicety — for members of the Sai Organisation it is their very life breath.

reflection: Swami makes unity a matter of life, not preference: differences of role, country or language must not divide people who share one family. Today, bridge one small divide — reconcile with someone you have drifted from, or include someone who is usually left out of a group decision. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31, 20 Nov 1998)

video.title: Self-Transformation Towards Oneness | Dr. Suresh Govind at Sathya Sai International Conference, USA

seva_nudge: Do one thing today that brings people together — invite someone who is usually on the edge of the group to join your table or your bhajan circle.
